description: This file defines structures and functions related to Content Security Policy (CSP) headers in a web server context, including nonce generation, template handling, and application to HTTP responses.

classes.name: ContentSecurityPolicy
classes.description: Represents a CSP with a nonce for security headers.

classes.name: ContentSecurityPolicyTemplate
classes.description: Template for CSP header with nonce placeholder, supporting nonce formatting.

methods.name: ContentSecurityPolicy::with_random_nonce
methods.description: Creates a new CSP instance with a randomly generated nonce.

methods.name: ContentSecurityPolicy::apply_to_response
methods.description: Applies the CSP header with a generated nonce to an HTTP response.

methods.name: ContentSecurityPolicyTemplate::is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the template has a nonce placeholder and is enabled.

methods.name: ContentSecurityPolicyTemplate::format_nonce
methods.description: Formats the template by replacing the nonce placeholder with the actual nonce.

methods.name: Default for ContentSecurityPolicyTemplate
methods.description: Provides default CSP template based on DEFAULT_CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY.

methods.name: From<&str> for ContentSecurityPolicyTemplate
methods.description: Creates a CSP template from a string, identifying nonce placeholder position.

methods.name: Deserialize<'de> for ContentSecurityPolicyTemplate
methods.description: Deserializes a CSP template from a string in a data format.
